description: The Widuchowa weir (Odra km 704.1) closes the West Oder less than 100 m below where it leaves the Oder; boats on the Hohensaaten-Friedrichsthal waterway cannot pass it to the East Oder. OSM maps no weir there, so the West Oder's end was joined to the Oder through the river-area mesh. Source: https://www.gov.pl/web/wody-polskie-szczecin/calkowite-otwarcie-jazu-w-widuchowej--sygnalem-rozpoczecia-zimowego-sezonu
